operations.summary: Create a versioned WAF, CC or ACL policy
operations.summary_zh: 创建带版本的 WAF 规则库、CC 或访问控制策略
operations.description: Requires security_policies.manage. Platform identities must provide an active tenant target_scope_id and owner_id; tenant identities are fixed to their current scope and identity. Rule IDs are server-generated and identical idempotent replay returns the original IDs. This control-plane slice does not claim edge publication or enforcement.
operations.description_zh: 需要 security_policies.manage 权限。平台身份必须提供有效租户的 target_scope_id 与 owner_id；租户身份固定为当前作用域和身份。 规则 ID 由服务端生成，同一幂等请求重放返回原 ID。创建只保存配置，不代表已发布到节点或已生效。

operations.summary: Enable, disable or delete selected WAF rule libraries item by item
operations.summary_zh: 逐项启用、停用或删除选中的 WAF 规则库
operations.description: Requires security_policies.manage. Each item is written on its own with a version check (CAS) under an item key derived from Idempotency-Key, so retrying the same batch replays written items. Results come back in request order, one per item; refusals (version conflict, system library, not found, in use, ...) are item results and do not stop the batch. A store failure marks that item error and the rest not_attempted. System (platform) libraries are never modified.
operations.description_zh: 需要 security_policies.manage 权限。每一项单独按版本号校验后写入，幂等键按 Idempotency-Key 逐项派生，重试同一批次会重放已写入的项。 结果按请求顺序逐项返回；版本冲突、系统规则库、不存在、使用中等拒绝都作为该项结果，不中断整批。存储失败时该项为 error，其余为 not_attempted。 平台（系统）规则库永远不会被修改。

responses.description: One result per item, in request order.
responses.description_zh: 每项一个结果，按请求顺序。

operations.summary_zh: 预览策略对一次请求的判定结果
operations.description: Requires security_policies.read and an exact If-Match version. Conditions within a rule are ANDed; rules are ordered by ascending priority and UUID. continue preserves the current decision while evaluation continues, stop returns the terminal decision, and the policy default applies only when no rule matches. Preview does not publish configuration or prove edge enforcement.
operations.description_zh: 需要 security_policies.read 权限，并用 If-Match 指定准确版本。同一规则内的条件取“且”；规则按优先级升序、再按 UUID 排序。continue 保留当前判定继续评估，stop 返回最终判定，没有规则命中时才用策略默认动作。预览不发布配置，也不代表节点已生效。

fields.name: headers
fields.description: Header names are case-insensitive; arrays preserve repeated field values. Scalar values remain accepted for legacy clients.
